sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized debit card activity identified following a fraud dispute initiated by customer C09988. On December 11, 2016, at 22:39:08 UTC, an online purchase totaling $59.67 was processed against the customer's Visa debit card C09988-K1. The customer subsequently contacted the bank to dispute the transaction, explicitly stating that they did not authorize or conduct the purchase. The online transaction was initiated through an electronic commerce channel utilizing a Hotmail email address. Technical analysis revealed that the payment originated from a Windows desktop device operating Microsoft Edge, which was previously unseen on the customer's profile. Further investigation established that this same device has been shared across four distinct customer accounts and four separate payment cards, generating 78 transactions. This pattern indicates that the card credentials were compromised and utilized in an unauthorized manner via an organized multi-account device ring, likely for card testing or fraudulent exploitation. In response to the confirmed unauthorized activity, the financial institution blocked the impacted debit card to mitigate further loss and maintains ongoing monitoring of all associated identifiers.
